cell_line.evidence: We investigated changes in the proteome of NIH-3T3 fibroblasts upon induction of cytotoxic stress (valinomycin, myrtucommulone A or serum depletion) and SCD1 inhibition (CAY10566) and addressed the potential of oleic acid (18:1), PI(18:1/18:1) and PI(16:0/16:0) to compensate for the decrease in de novo fatty acid biosynthesis.
